scope: three displayed VP8 keyframes, native YUV420 plane comparison; no interframe qualification
ffmpeg_version: ffmpeg version 9.0.2 Copyright (c) 2000-2026 the FFmpeg developers
commands: ffmpeg -hide_banner -loglevel error -f lavfi -i 'testsrc2=size=48x32:rate=3:duration=1' -c:v libvpx -g 1 -deadline best -cpu-used 0 -b:v 0 -crf 20 -auto-alt-ref 0 -threads 1 -y vp8-keyframes.webm
ffmpeg -hide_banner -loglevel error -i vp8-keyframes.webm -pix_fmt yuv420p -f rawvideo -y vp8-keyframes.yuv
